name: shopping-research
description: Product search, cross-retailer prices, Amazon price history, and community deals over free sources, with self-reported coverage on every call.
long_description: A local MCP server for shopping research. It searches Google Shopping through SerpApi and eBay through the Browse API, reads any product page, loads Amazon price history from CamelCamelCamel in a browser window that opens for a moment, and lists Slickdeals community deals. Every answer names the sources it checked and the sources it skipped, so a best price always means the lowest among the sources checked. Each API key is optional; a source without its key is reported as skipped.

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Find candidate products across Google Shopping, eBay, and Target when enabled.

tools.name: get_condition
tools.description: New or second-hand condition of a search result, at no quota.

tools.name: extract_product
tools.description: Title, price, currency, and availability from any product page.

tools.name: get_price_history
tools.description: Amazon price history from CamelCamelCamel, read in a browser window that opens for a moment.

tools.name: c1_check
tools.description: Optional Capital One Shopping cross-check on one finalist, off by default.

tools.name: get_status
tools.description: Which sources are configured and how many SerpApi searches are left this month.

serpapi_key.title: SerpApi API key
serpapi_key.description: Free key from serpapi.com (250 searches a month). Powers Google Shopping search and per-merchant offers. Leave blank to run without it.

serpapi_monthly_budget.title: SerpApi monthly budget
serpapi_monthly_budget.description: Hard stop on SerpApi searches per calendar month. The server refuses calls past it.

ebay_client_id.title: eBay client ID
ebay_client_id.description: App ID of a production keyset from developer.ebay.com. Leave blank to skip eBay.

ebay_client_secret.title: eBay client secret
ebay_client_secret.description: Cert ID of the same keyset; the server fetches and caches its own OAuth token.

target_enabled.title: Query Target
target_enabled.description: Off by default. Target's search endpoint is undocumented and refuses most automated requests; turn on to try it, and a refusal is reported as blocked.
